I'm so glad we're all finally together, it's been ages. How's work been treating you, Sarah? Ah, it's been keeping me busy, that's for sure. I'm so glad we're doing this, I needed a break from all the commotion about the library. I know, it's crazy. I was talking to some of the locals and they're all up in arms about it. I'm so glad you're here, we've been meaning to get the fireplace sorted for ages. Ah, yes, the log burner. We've been talking about getting one installed for months now. Okay, who's ready for pizza? I am! I am! Me too! Great! Let's get started then. Who can tell me what toppings they want? I want cheese and tomato! And I want pepperoni! Excellent choices! Okay kids, gather around. I want to talk to you about something important. What makes you happy? I'm happy when I play with my toys! And I'm happy when I play with my cars! That's great!
